jobs.title: Abteilungsleiter:in Logistik (100%)
jobs.description:
Du führst und coachst deine Teams durch eine starke Wachstumsphase, optimierst Prozesse und hältst unsere Logistikwelt am Laufen – von der Warenannahme bis zum Hochregal-Roboter. Wenn du Lust hast, Führung zu übernehmen, Prozesse zu meistern und Innovation zu treiben, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Was wirst du tun

• Führen, motivieren, entwickeln : Du stärkst und entwickelst deine Teamleitende und Mitarbeitende (total ca. 80 Mitarbeitende) gezielt weiter, förderst Führungskompetenzen und begleitest die Organisation durch eine dynamische Wachstumsphase.

• Personal- und Einsatzplanung meistern : Optimale Schichtplanung (3-Schichtbetrieb), Notfallorganisation und Ressourcenmanagement liegen in deiner Hand.

• Leistung, Qualität und Kosten im Griff : Du verantwortest Warenannahme, Lagerung, Kommissionierung, Entsorgung und Versand – inklusive Budgets, Inventur und Bestandsführung.

• Technik & Anlagenbetrieb: Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit aller Anlagen sicher (inkl. hochautomatisiertem Hochregal- und Kleinteilelager und externem Aussenlager).

• Logistikprozesse optimieren: Qualität und Effizienz – Du entwickelst Prozesse weiter, beschaffst Investitionsgüter und sorgst für deren nachhaltige Instandhaltung sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung im Sinne des KVP.

• HSSE & Compliance leben : Arbeitssicherheit, Gesundheit, Umwelt, gesetzliche Vorgaben, ISO-Standards und interne Richtlinien – Du hältst alles ein und entwickelst es weiter.

• Reporting & Steuerung : Statistiken, KPI und BSC-Reports dienen dir als Basis, um die Logistikperformance kontinuierlich zu überwachen und zu verbessern.

• Qualität & Projekte: Unterstützung bei Qualitätsfällen, Prozessmitteilungen und aktive Teilnahme an relevanten Projekten.

Wer du bist

• Abgeschlossene technische oder logistische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Logistiker/in EFZ) plus höhere Fachausbildung im Logistikbereich

• Langjährige Führungserfahrung mit Verantwortung für grosse Teams (mind. 80 Personen) sowie der Fähigkeit, Teams und Führungskräfte in einem dynamischen Wachstumsfeld zu begleiten und weiterzuentwickeln

• Mind. 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung in internationalen Industrie-, Handels- oder Logistikunternehmen im Bereich Operations mit Fokus auf Logistik

• Fundierte Erfahrung in der erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Operational-Excellence-Initiativen, Prozessoptimierung, Change Management und bereichsübergreifenden Transformationsprojekten

• Sehr gute IT- und SAP-Kenntnisse (SD, MM, PP, EWM) und sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch (mind. B2)

• Unternehmerisches Denken, Entscheidungsfreude und hohe Selbstständigkeit

• Teamplayer mit Durchsetzungsstärke: starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Konfliktkompetenz, Zuverlässigkeit und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

• Praktische Voraussetzungen: Elektrodeichselstapler-Prüfung und Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit

Wer wir sind

Bei Belimo sind wir stolz darauf, unser Unternehmen zu einem lohnenden Arbeitsplatz zu machen. Unsere Führungskräfte sind werteorientiert und fördern neue Ideen in ihren Teams auf der ganzen Welt. Durch unsere Leidenschaft schaffen unsere Mitarbeiter nicht nur erstaunliche Produkte, sondern revolutionieren auch die HLK-Branche. Die Investition in unsere Mitarbeitenden ist das Herzstück von Belimo, wenn es darum geht, verschiedene kreative Talente zu engagieren, um ein branchenführendes Unternehmen aufzubauen. Der Erfolg unserer Unternehmensmarke basiert auf der Kompetenz und dem Engagement jedes Einzelnen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Guidate e allenate i vostri team attraverso una forte fase di crescita, ottimizzate i processi e tenete in funzione il nostro mondo della logistica – dal ricevimento delle merci ai robot high-bay. Se ti senti come assumere la leadership, padroneggiare i processi e guidare l'innovazione, sei al posto giusto con noi.

Cosa farai

• Guidare, motivare, sviluppare: rafforzare e sviluppare i vostri leader e dipendenti del team (totale circa 80 dipendenti) in modo mirato, promuovere competenze di leadership e accompagnare l'organizzazione attraverso una fase di crescita dinamica.

• Personale di masterizzazione e pianificazione delle assegnazioni: Pianificazione ottimale dei turni (3 turni), gestione delle emergenze e gestione delle risorse sono nelle vostre mani.

• Prestazioni, qualità e costi sotto controllo: Lei è responsabile per la ricevuta di merci, lo stoccaggio, la raccolta, lo smaltimento e la spedizione – compresi i bilanci, l'inventario e la gestione dell'inventario.

• Tecnologia e funzionamento degli impianti: Garantisci la disponibilità di tutti gli impianti (inclusi i magazzini di alta sicurezza e piccole parti altamente automatizzati e il magazzino esterno).

• Ottimizzare i processi logistici: Qualità ed efficienza – Si sviluppano processi ulteriormente, procurano beni di capitale e garantiscono la loro manutenzione sostenibile e il miglioramento continuo nel senso del CIP.

• HSSE & compliance living: sicurezza del lavoro, salute, ambiente, requisiti legali, norme ISO e linee guida interne Tieni tutto e lo sviluppi ulteriormente.

• Reporting & Control: Le statistiche, i rapporti KPI e BSC servono come base per monitorare e migliorare continuamente le prestazioni logistiche.

• Qualità & Progetti: Supporto per casi di qualità, comunicazioni di processo e partecipazione attiva a progetti rilevanti.

Chi sei

• Formazione professionale tecnica o logistica completa (ad es. logistica/EFZ) e formazione specialistica superiore nella logistica

• Molti anni di esperienza manageriale con responsabilità per grandi squadre (almeno 80 persone) e la capacità di accompagnare e sviluppare team e manager in un campo di crescita dinamico

• Mente. 10 anni di esperienza professionale in aziende industriali, commerciali o logistiche internazionali nel campo delle operazioni con focus sulla logistica

• Esperienza approfondita nella riuscita realizzazione di iniziative di eccellenza operativa, ottimizzazione dei processi, gestione dei cambiamenti e progetti di trasformazione trasversale

• Molto buone competenze IT e SAP (SD, MM, PP, EWM) e comunicazione sicura in tedesco (minimo C1) e inglese (minimo B2)

• pensiero imprenditoriale, piacere decisionale e alta indipendenza

• Team player con assertività: forti capacità di comunicazione, competenza di conflitto, affidabilità e metodi di lavoro strutturati

• Prerequisiti pratici: test di stacker elettrodo e prontezza per il lavoro a turni

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e promuovono nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, ma anche rivoluzionano l'industria HVAC. Investire nei nostri dipendenti è al centro di Belimo quando si tratta di coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per costruire una società leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
You lead and coach your teams through a strong growth phase, optimize processes and keep our logistics world running – from goods receipt to high-bay robots. If you feel like taking on leadership, mastering processes and driving innovation, you are at the right place with us.

What will you do

• Lead, motivate, develop: You will strengthen and develop your team leaders and employees (total about 80 employees) in a targeted manner, promote leadership skills and accompany the organization through a dynamic growth phase.

• Mastering personnel and assignment planning: Optimal shift planning (3-shift operation), emergency management and resource management are in your hands.

• Performance, quality and costs under control: You are responsible for goods receipt, storage, picking, disposal and shipping – including budgets, inventory and inventory management.

• Technology & plant operation: You ensure the availability of all plants (including highly automated high-bay and small parts warehouse and external external warehouse).

• Optimize logistics processes: Quality and efficiency – You develop processes further, procure capital goods and ensure their sustainable maintenance and continuous improvement in the sense of the CIP.

• HSSE & compliance living: occupational safety, health, environment, legal requirements, ISO standards and internal guidelines You keep everything and develop it further.

• Reporting & Control: Statistics, KPI and BSC reports serve as a basis for you to continuously monitor and improve logistics performance.

• Quality & Projects: Support for quality cases, process communications and active participation in relevant projects.

Who you are

• Completed technical or logistical vocational training (e.g. logistician/EFZ) plus higher specialist training in logistics

• Many years of management experience with responsibility for large teams (at least 80 people) as well as the ability to accompany and develop teams and managers in a dynamic growth field

• Mind. 10 years of professional experience in international industrial, commercial or logistics companies in the field of operations with focus on logistics

• In-depth experience in the successful implementation of operational excellence initiatives, process optimization, change management and cross-divisional transformation projects

• Very good IT and SAP skills (SD, MM, PP, EWM) and secure communication in German (minimum C1) and English (minimum B2)

• Entrepreneurial thinking, decision-making pleasure and high independence

• Team player with assertiveness: strong communication skills, conflict competence, reliability and structured working methods

• Practical prerequisites: electrode stacker testing and readiness for shift work

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees not only create amazing products, but also revolutionize the HVAC industry. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.

Vous dirigez et coachez vos équipes à travers une phase de croissance forte, optimisez les processus et maintenez notre monde logistique en marche – de la réception des marchandises aux robots à grande baie. Si vous avez envie de prendre le leadership, de maîtriser les processus et de stimuler l'innovation, vous êtes au bon endroit avec nous.

Que ferez-vous ?

• Dirigez, motivez, développez : Vous renforcerez et développerez vos chefs d'équipe et vos employés (environ 80 employés) de manière ciblée, favoriserez les compétences en leadership et accompagnerez l'organisation dans une phase de croissance dynamique.

• Maîtriser le personnel et la planification des affectations : La planification optimale des postes (3 postes), la gestion des urgences et la gestion des ressources sont entre vos mains.

• Performance, qualité et coûts sous contrôle : Vous êtes responsable de la réception, de l'entreposage, de la cueillette, de l'élimination et de l'expédition des marchandises – y compris les budgets, les stocks et la gestion des stocks.

• Technologie & exploitation de l'usine: Vous assurez la disponibilité de toutes les usines (y compris l'entrepôt haute baie et petites pièces hautement automatisé et l'entrepôt externe externe).

• Optimiser les processus logistiques : Qualité et efficacité – Vous développez les processus, achetez des biens d'équipement et assurez leur maintenance durable et leur amélioration continue au sens du CIP.

• HSSE & compliance living: sécurité au travail, santé, environnement, exigences légales, normes ISO et lignes directrices internes Vous gardez tout et développez plus loin.

• Reporting & Control: Les statistiques, les rapports KPI et BSC servent de base au suivi et à l'amélioration continus des performances logistiques.

• Qualité & Projets: Soutien à des cas de qualité, à la communication des processus et à la participation active à des projets pertinents.

Qui vous êtes

• Formation professionnelle technique ou logistique terminée (par exemple logisticien/EFZ) plus formation spécialisée supérieure en logistique

• De nombreuses années d'expérience en gestion avec la responsabilité de grandes équipes (au moins 80 personnes) ainsi que la capacité d'accompagner et de développer des équipes et des gestionnaires dans un domaine de croissance dynamique

• De rien. 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les entreprises industrielles, commerciales ou logistiques internationales dans le domaine des opérations en mettant l'accent sur la logistique

• Expérience approfondie de la mise en œuvre réussie des initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle, de l'optimisation des processus, de la gestion du changement et des projets de transformation interdivisions

• Très bonnes compétences informatiques et SAP (SD, MM, PP, EWM) et communication sécurisée en allemand (minimum C1) et en anglais (minimum B2)

• Pensée entrepreneuriale, plaisir de prendre des décisions et grande indépendance

• Joueur d'équipe avec assertion: fortes compétences en communication, compétence en conflit, fiabilité et méthodes de travail structurées

• Prérequis pratiques: essais de empileur d'électrodes et préparation au travail posté

jobs.title: Technical Service Specialist, Taiwan
jobs.description:
Summary

The role provides technical support, site supervision, testing & commissioning and training to Belimo Key Customers for all Belimo product ranges in Taiwan. The calibre shall support the Sales Director on striving customer satisfaction in OEM industry with strong technical background. The calibre shall take care of OEM customers and related stakeholders such as consultants and building owners to facilitate business growth.

What You'll Do

• Provide technical expertise and application support for HVAC systems, including Chiller Plants, PAUs, AHUs, fan extraction systems, VAV systems, and data center fan wall applications.

• Support system design reviews, product selection, troubleshooting, and commissioning activities to ensure optimal system performance and customer satisfaction.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to support project and business objectives.

• Collaborate with sales teams to identify customer needs and develop technical solutions that meet project specifications and performance requirements.

• Work with cross-functional teams to develop and execute product launch plans, ensuring successful market introduction and adoption.

• Conduct technical presentations, product demonstrations, and training sessions for customers, partners, and internal teams.

• Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging HVAC technologies, providing feedback to support product development and business growth initiatives.

Who You Are

• Degree in Automation, HVAC, Mechanical, Electronics, or related Engineering disciplines; Diploma holders with relevant experience will also be considered.

• 2-4 years of experience in the HVAC industry or a related technical field for the Technical Support Engineer position.

• Candidates with 4+ years of relevant HVAC experience may be considered for the Assistant Technical Support Manager position.

• Good command of written and spoken English.

• Solid knowledge of hydronic, hydraulic, and control systems.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications; SAP and CRM knowledge is an advantage.

• Strong communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills with customers and business partners.

• Self-motivated, customer-oriented, and willing to travel as required.

Who We Are

At Belimo, we take pride in making our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. Investing in our people is at the heart of Belimo's approach to engaging diverse creative talent to grow an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the expertise and commitment of each individual.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi

Il ruolo fornisce supporto tecnico, supervisione del sito, test & messa in servizio e formazione ai clienti chiave Belimo per tutte le gamme di prodotti Belimo a Taiwan. Il calibro sosterrà il Direttore Vendite sull'impegno della soddisfazione del cliente nell'industria OEM con un forte background tecnico. Il calibro si prenderà cura dei clienti OEM e dei relativi stakeholder come consulenti e proprietari di edifici per facilitare la crescita aziendale.

Cosa farai

• Fornire competenze tecniche e supporto alle applicazioni per sistemi HVAC, tra cui Chiller Plants, PAUs, AHUs, sistemi di estrazione dei ventilatori, sistemi VAV e applicazioni di fan wall del data center.

• Recensioni di progettazione del sistema di supporto, selezione del prodotto, risoluzione dei problemi e attività di messa in servizio per garantire prestazioni ottimali del sistema e soddisfazione del cliente.

• Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con clienti, consulenti, appaltatori, fornitori e altri stakeholder per sostenere obiettivi di progetto e business.

• Collabora con i team di vendita per identificare le esigenze dei clienti e sviluppare soluzioni tecniche che soddisfino le specifiche del progetto e i requisiti di performance.

• Lavorare con team interfunzionali per sviluppare ed eseguire i piani di lancio del prodotto, assicurando l'introduzione e l'adozione del mercato di successo.

• Condurre presentazioni tecniche, dimostrazioni di prodotto e sessioni di formazione per clienti, partner e team interni.

• Monitorare le tendenze del mercato, le attività concorrenti e le tecnologie emergenti HVAC, fornendo feedback per sostenere le iniziative di sviluppo del prodotto e crescita aziendale.

Chi sei

• Laurea in Automazione, HVAC, Meccanica, Elettronica, o relative discipline ingegneristiche; I titolari di Diploma con esperienza rilevante saranno anche considerati.

• 2-4 anni di esperienza nell'industria HVAC o un campo tecnico correlato per la posizione dell'ingegnere di supporto tecnico.

• I candidati con 4+ anni di esperienza HVAC rilevante possono essere considerati per la posizione Assistant Technical Support Manager.

• Buon comando di inglese scritto e parlato.

• Conoscenza solida dei sistemi idronici, idraulici e di controllo.

• Proficiente nelle applicazioni Microsoft Office; la conoscenza SAP e CRM è un vantaggio.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, interpersonale e relazionale con clienti e partner commerciali.

• Automotivato, orientato al cliente, e disposto a viaggiare come richiesto.

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e incoraggiano nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, stanno rivoluzionando l'industria HVAC. Investire nella nostra gente è al centro dell'approccio di Belimo a coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per crescere un'azienda leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.

jobs.title: Systems Architect (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Summary

As a Systems Architect, you will shape and lead scalable systems architectures that enable long-term product growth and cross-domain integration. You act as a key technical authority, translating business and system requirements into robust architectural solutions while guiding teams and stakeholders across the organization.

What You'll Do

• Lead and coordinate the design of scalable systems architectures across products and projects.

• Identify architectural needs, define solution options, and drive informed architectural decisions.

• Act as the main contact for cross-domain architectural challenges (hardware, software, networks).

• Ensure alignment with architectural principles, standards, and strategic objectives.

• Translate requirements into architecture artifacts (drivers, constraints, quality attributes).

• Define and govern standardized interfaces for seamless system integration.

• Provide technical leadership through mentoring, workshops, and architectural guidance.

• Document, communicate, and continuously improve architectural decisions and methodologies.

Who You Are

• Engineering degree (e.g. Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics).

• Several years of experience in systems architecture for embedded devices.

• Strong expertise in hardware and cross-domain integration.

• Experience with architectural methods, MBSE tools, and systems engineering practices.

• Proven ability to lead technical decisions and align interdisciplinary stakeholders.

• Experience in technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Familiarity with architecture governance, standards, and continuous improvement.

• Excellent English skills, strong communication and presentation abilities, and a holistic mindset.

Who We Are

At Belimo, we take pride in making our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. Investing in our people is at the heart of Belimo's approach to engaging diverse creative talent to grow an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the expertise and commitment of each individual.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Gemeinsam mit einem engagierten Team entwickelst du hochmoderne Mixed-Signal ASICs und übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für den analogen Teil unserer Chips. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit internen Expert:innen sowie externen Entwicklungspartnern zusammen und begleitest innovative Lösungen von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Integration ins Produkt.

Was wirst du tun

• Spezifikation und Verifikation des analogen Teils unserer Mixed-Signal-ASICs.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem ASIC-Lieferanten bei der Entwicklung und Lösung technischer Herausforderungen im Analogbereich.

• Übernahme der technischen Schnittstellenfunktion zum internen Digitaldesign-Team sowie zum System-Verifikationsteam.

• Entwicklung, Aufbau und Pflege von Leiterplatten für die Entwicklung und Qualifizierung unserer ASICs.

• Entwurf und Bewertung neuer analoger Schaltungskonzepte für zukünftige Funktionen und Anwendungen.

• Analyse, Verifikation und Optimierung von Schaltungseigenschaften zur Sicherstellung höchster Qualitätsstandards.

• Unterstützung bei der Integration unserer ASICs in innovative Belimo-Produkte.

• Aktive Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams, um Technologien erfolgreich von der Idee bis zur Anwendung zu begleiten.

Wer du bist

• Masterabschluss in Elektrotechnik, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Mikroelektronik oder Analogelektronik.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im analogen Schaltungsdesign und in der Messtechnik.

• Fundiertes Verständnis für analoge Schaltungen und deren Verifikation.

• Erfahrung in Mikroelektronik, Requirements Engineering oder Verifikationsmethoden ist ein Plus.

• Interesse an digitalen Schaltungen und Technologien wie Verilog oder VHDL.

• Begeisterung für neue Technologien und innovative Lösungen.

• Selbstständige, qualitätsorientierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie eine offene und kommunikative Persönlichkeit.

Wer wir sind

Bei Belimo sind wir stolz darauf, unser Unternehmen zu einem lohnenden Arbeitsplatz zu machen. Unsere Führungskräfte sind werteorientiert und fördern neue Ideen in ihren Teams auf der ganzen Welt. Durch unsere Leidenschaft schaffen unsere Mitarbeiter nicht nur erstaunliche Produkte, sondern revolutionieren auch die HLK-Branche. Die Investition in unsere Mitarbeitenden ist das Herzstück von Belimo, wenn es darum geht, verschiedene kreative Talente zu engagieren, um ein branchenführendes Unternehmen aufzubauen. Der Erfolg unserer Unternehmensmarke basiert auf der Kompetenz und dem Engagement jedes Einzelnen.

jobs.title: Trusted Firmware Verification Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced Trusted Firmware Verification Engineer to integrate, test, and validate secure embedded firmware solutions. The role combines vendor management with technical ownership in the fields of cybersecurity, firmware verification, and test automation for ARM-based platforms.

What You'll Do

• Perform test specification and implementation of embedded firmware and security-related software components, validation, debugging, and root-cause analysis.

• Design and execute automated test solutions and validation frameworks.

• Implement and verify Secure Boot, Secure Update, Secure Storage, Secure Recovery, and Firmware Signing.

• Coordinate external development packages and assume ownership of selected deliverables.

• Support firmware release, maintenance, and security compliance activities.

• Review requirements specifications

Who You Are

• BSc or MSc in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience in embedded software development, firmware testing, and debugging of embedded devices.

• Knowledge of Trusted Firmware-M (TF-M), PSA APIs, secure firmware concepts, and security-focused embedded systems.

• Experience with verification and validation methodologies, including white-box and black-box testing.

• Familiarity with test automation frameworks and automated validation environments, ideally Robot Framework.

• Good understanding of ARM Cortex architectures, RTOS-based systems, and embedded communication protocols.

• Proficiency in Embedded C++ and Python

• Fluent English communication skills

Who We Are

At Belimo, we take pride in making our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. Investing in our people is at the heart of Belimo's approach to engaging diverse creative talent to grow an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the expertise and commitment of each individual.
